# 101conv

> 101conv is a private, self-hosted workspace for converting, compressing, assembling, inspecting, and automating files. The name is provisional.

This is a concise project index for search crawlers and assistant tools. It is
informational only; it is not an API, a deployment configuration, or a promise
that every deployment exposes every capability.

## Project

- Repository: https://github.com/Timisah/101conv
- Installation and deployment: https://github.com/Timisah/101conv#readme
- Public information page: /about/
- Project status and verified evidence: https://github.com/Timisah/101conv/blob/main/docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md

## Workspace areas

- Convert: submit supported files to installed, versioned conversion profiles.
- Compress: set quality or bounded size goals and inspect actual output savings.
- Build: expand multi-page PDFs, arrange pages non-destructively in saved or expiring projects, and export PDF (native vector text + verbatim JPEG bytes), CBZ, ordered-images ZIP, multipage TIFF, DOCX, PPTX, ODT, or ODP.
- Inspect: run an ephemeral, bounded metadata scan without adding the source to conversion storage.
- Automate: use registered mounted-folder blueprints with metadata conditions, stable-file checks, history, and safe publication.

## Verified catalog scope

- Images: JPG/JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, GIF, and AVIF image profiles; JPEG XL 1.3.0 (quality, effort, lossless) and JPEG XL compression; animated web loops (GIF/WebP/APNG/MP4/WebM).
- Audio/video: FFmpeg 1.3.0 conversion, VP9 compression (`ffmpeg-compression-linux-amd64` 1.1.0), and Audio Mastering 1.0.0 (Opus/AAC/MP3/FLAC/WAV/M4A/OGG with EBU R128 loudness normalization).
- Documents: DOCX/DOC/ODT/XLSX/XLS/ODS/PPTX/PPT/ODP/RTF/TXT to PDF; PDF to PNG/JPG/JPEG or TXT through managed document profiles on supported Linux AMD64 deployments; visual Document Creator with 8 export formats.
- Catalog rules and provenance: https://github.com/Timisah/101conv/blob/main/docs/profiles/catalog-format.md

## Important limits

- A deployment exposes only the engines and profiles its administrator installs.
- Format pairs, animation behavior, metadata mapping, HDR preservation, and exact target-size results are profile- and engine-specific; HDR10+/Dolby Vision dynamic metadata is explicitly rejected until verified per codec.
- Document Creator Office exports (DOCX/PPTX/ODT/ODP) are paginated image documents, not OCR or editable text reconstruction.
- The public page is informational. An optional isolated public demo stack (`compose.demo.yaml`) exists for resource-limited evaluation, but private self-hosting remains the default.
